bio.short: GM, Pedal Performance · Sr. Director of Enablement, Pearmill · I build agent systems for marketing teams. New Paltz, NY.
bio.medium: I'm the GM of Pedal Performance, an AI-native performance marketing agency for medical, DTC and growing businesses, and Sr. Director of Enablement at Pearmill, the growth agency behind it. Most of my work is building the agent systems that let a small team do a big team's job: Claude Code skills that encode judgment, ad-platform data pipelines reconciled to the P&L, and client portals. Every lesson becomes a rule, and every rule gets a check.
bio.long: I'm the GM of Pedal Performance, an AI-native performance marketing agency for medical, DTC and growing businesses, and Sr. Director of Enablement at Pearmill, the growth agency behind it ($500M+ in ad spend managed). Most of my work is building the agent systems that let a small team do a big team's job: Claude Code skills that encode judgment, ad-platform data pipelines reconciled to the P&L, and client portals. Every lesson becomes a rule, and every rule gets a check. Outside client work I run a self-hosted research newsdesk that collects sources on topics I want to understand better. I live in New Paltz, NY.
